13 January–16 May 2026 | winners = | relegated = | continentalcup1 = [[CONCACAF Central American Cup|Central American Cup]] | continentalcup1 qualifiers= | matches = | matches footnote = | total goals = | total goals footnote = | average goals = | best player = | league topscorer = | best goalkeeper = | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest winless = | longest losses = | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2024–25 Liga FPD|2024–25]] | nextseason = 2026–27 | updated = | extra information = }} The '''2025–26 Liga FPD''', also known as '''Liga Promérica''' for sponsorship reasons,{{cite web |title=UNAFUT y Banco Promerica firman extensión histórica de patrocinio hasta 2030 |url=https://www.promerica.fi.cr/nuestro-banco/liga-promerica/unafut-y-banco-promerica-firman-extension-historica-de-patrocinio-hasta-2030/ |publisher=Banco Promerica Costa Rica |access-date=3 July 2025 |language=es |date=26 September 2024}} was the 105th season of the [[Liga FPD]], Costa Rica's top-flight tournament. It began with the Apertura tournament on 27 July 2025. The season was played with ten teams, down from the traditional twelve, as a result of [[A.D. Guanacasteca|Guanacasteca]] and [[Santos de Guápiles F.C.|Santos de Guápiles]] being disqualified and having their licenses revoked. [[C.S. Herediano|Herediano]] are the defending champions, having won both tournaments of [[2024–25 Liga FPD|the previous season]], being their 30th and 31st titles. The season also reintroduced the promoted side [[Guadalupe F.C.|Guadalupe]], who return after their relegation in 2023.{{cite news |last1=Fonseca |first1=Alejandro |title=Guadalupe asciende a la Primera División del fútbol tico |url=https://www.diarioextra.com/noticia/guadalupe-asciende-a-la-primera-division-del-futbol-tico/ |access-date=3 July 2025 |work=Diario Extra |date=1 June 2025 |language=es}} == Competition format == The season was played with ten teams, down from the traditional twelve, as a result of [[A.D. Guanacasteca|Guanacasteca]] and [[Santos de Guápiles F.C.|Santos de Guápiles]] being disqualified and having their licenses revoked.{{cite news |last1=Vargas |first1=Dinia |title=Torneo con 10 equipos: Así será el calendario del Apertura 2025 {{!}} CRHoy.com |url=https://crhoy.com/torneo-con-10-equipos-asi-sera-el-calendario-del-apertura-2025/ |access-date=3 July 2025 |work=CRHoy.com {{!}} Periodico Digital {{!}} Costa Rica Noticias 24/7 |date=3 July 2025 |language=es}}{{cite news |last1=Vargas |first1=Dinia |title=Guanacasteca y Santos acudieron al TAS y al ICODER en busca de recuperar sus licencias {{!}} CRHoy.com |url=https://crhoy.com/guanacasteca-y-santos-acudieron-al-tas-y-al-icoder-en-busca-de-recuperar-sus-licencias/ |access-date=3 July 2025 |work=CRHoy.com {{!}} Periodico Digital {{!}} Costa Rica Noticias 24/7 |date=3 July 2025 |language=es}} Therefore, the season's regular phase consisted of 18 matchdays. Otherwise the competition format was unchanged from the previous season.{{Cite web |last=Solano |first=Hermes |date=2025-06-28 |title=Definido el nuevo campeonato nacional en Costa Rica: 10 equipos y 18 fechas de fase regular |url=https://observador.cr/definido-el-nuevo-campeonato-nacional-en-costa-rica-10-equipos-y-18-fechas-de-fase-regular/ |access-date=2026-06-18 |website=El Observador CR |language=es}} The season was divided into [[Apertura and Clausura]] tournaments, with the Apertura scheduled to place between 27 July and 21 December 2025, and the Clausura between 11 January and 27 May 2026. In both tournaments, a regular phase of 18 matches is played, before the top four advance to the play-offs, which is a four-team knockout competition.
